tasks.setup: deno run --allow-read --allow-run --allow-write src/bootstrap/config.ts && deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/gen-shape-docs.ts
tasks.compile: deno task setup && deno compile --allow-read --allow-net --allow-env --allow-run -o dist/shape-checker src/bootstrap/mod.ts
tasks.deploy: test -n "$SHAPE_DEPLOY_DIR" || { echo 'Error: set SHAPE_DEPLOY_DIR env var'; exit 1; } && cp dist/shape-checker "$SHAPE_DEPLOY_DIR/shape-checker" && xattr -cr "$SHAPE_DEPLOY_DIR/shape-checker" && codesign -s - "$SHAPE_DEPLOY_DIR/shape-checker"
